sources.observed_statement: The chat completions API documents response_format values text, json_object, and json_schema, and warns that generated output may not satisfy the requested effect.
The guide states that only some models support json_schema and lists DeepSeek-V4-Pro, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-5.1, GLM-5, and Qwen3-family open models.
The model list identifies exact model parameters glm-5.2 and kimi-k2.6.

known_limitations: Official documentation can change after observed_at.
General endpoint support does not prove exact-model support.
Absence from the listed support scope does not prove permanent non-support.
